claim.name: M8-M billing-provable 简体中文 Agent prompt successor
claim.primary_problem: M8-D v1-v4 的 evaluator identity 无效，v5 首个 arm 又以 canonical billing_unknown=true 停止；旧 arm 不能续跑、补 mate 或拼接。V15 仍需要一个 current same-revision、fixed-Pro、fail-before-loss、billing-provable prompt comparison。
claim.acceptance: 以 clean d1d6ca5c source 和同一 immutable codewhale/codewhale-tui binary pair，从 position 1 执行 5 tasks × 2 variants × 3 repetitions；除 constitution checklist treatment 外，revision、binary、workspace slot、task、model、reasoning、catalog、authority、budget、retry、verifier 与 request identity 必须逐对相同。每臂 canonical RunStore 必须证明全部 physical requests 都有同 model/surface usage response、cache token、cost、retry、terminal、verifier 和 exact reopen。
claim.single_owner: crates/context remains the only production prompt owner; AgentApplication composes it, AgentRuntime and RunStore persist it, crates/deepseek owns official ChatCompletions planning/transport/accounting, and the M8-M evaluator only journals canonical facts.
claim.replacement: 只有完整 30-arm formal suite 满足 verified-success non-regression、false success=0 与稳定净效率收益时，candidate 才直接替换 crates/context/src/prompts/constitution.md 的五步 checklist。
claim.cutover_deletion: 无论结论如何，M8-M successor 接管后删除失去消费者的 M8-D Python evaluator/test；M8-D frozen manifests、0600 raw 与 summary 保留作不可拼接历史证据。若 candidate 不通过，删除 M8-M candidate evaluation path 并保持 bundled production prompt 不变；若通过，直接替换 bundled 文本且不保留双默认、selector、mode 或 compatibility branch。

suite_lineage.base_contract: M8-D v5 manifest 只提供已冻结的五个 task fixture、tool authority 和 prompt delta provenance；M8-M 覆盖全部 suite、protocol、binary、model、pricing、budget、accounting、observer、admission 和 output identity。
suite_lineage.not_a_rerun: M8-D v1-v5 raw 全部保持不可覆盖；M8-M 使用 current d1d6ca5c production binary、fixed deepseek-v4-pro、Run API v11/RuntimeEvent v17/State v23/exec-stream v3、全新 suite/output 和 30 个全新 arm，maximum_reruns=0。

admission.admission_evidence: M8-M journal self-test and six SIGKILL fault windows pass; official ChatCompletions, V4 Pro pricing and thinking contracts were revalidated on 2026-07-24; the immutable d1d6ca5c binary pair passes prompt-only production activation with zero external requests and no-credential SQLite reopen; targeted, focused, fmt, workspace clippy/test, production loopback, process-level crash/reopen and Harness gates all pass; the worktree is clean before this admission-only change.
